name: What does the log and cabin refinishing process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the log and cabin refinishing process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional cabin maintenance typically starts with surface preparation, which involves washing or blasting away failing stain, dirt, and mildew. Once dry, contractors repair damaged wood, apply borate preservatives if needed, and re-caulk or chink gaps between log courses and around window casings. Finally, multiple coats of breathable, exterior-grade log stain and clear topcoat are applied. Working with a contractor who oversees the entire scope ensures prep, carpentry, and finishing are handled sequentially without gaps in protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refinishing involves cleaning or stripping old coatings, repairing damaged wood, sealing joints with chinking or caulking, and applying durable log stain.
